threshold_policy.binary_boundary_selection: Best balanced accuracy on the reviewed similar/different examples among the tested threshold grid; rounded exploratory estimate, not independent validation
threshold_policy.status: provisional, not a validated binary musical-similarity boundary
threshold_policy.rationale: 0.80 admits roughly half of all pairs. 0.85 keeps a narrower recommendation candidate set while retaining examples such as Hotel Rimini/Florian Paul and Wowakin/Kapela Janiszewskich. Higher cutoffs lose these plausible matches and still retain known false positives.
threshold_policy.below_threshold_meaning: Weaker text-embedding evidence; not proof of different musical styles
